## Requirement

Produce exactly nine non-dry scripted production records on the real production
path (no dry-run bypasses): three scenarios × three strategy arms. R5 is a local
engineering proof of the complete harness and orchestration. It does not
evaluate Qwen quality and must not be represented as model-quality evidence.

## Production defects found

Exactly one production defect was exposed by the production-path test and fixed
in the rewritten Commit B `875e4d1`: the regeneration executor wrote generated
migration files with platform default line endings, so on Windows the workspace
diff compared LF generated bytes against CRLF baseline bytes and counted an
infinite-precision diff as a new change. The fix preserves the exact generated
bytes with a CRLF-robust write (`target_path.write_text(..., newline="")`). No
other production defect was found. The rewritten commit contains exactly two
files: `src/benchmark/execution/regeneration.py` and
`tests/unit/execution/test_regeneration.py`.

### Exact selected/generated contract (tightened in the audit cleanup)

For all nine cells the positive assertion proves exact equality of:

```text
backend.generation_paths_requested
record.selected_artifact_count
record.regeneration_model_calls
record.regenerated_artifact_count
record.preserved_artifact_count
```

| scenario | monolithic | selective | agent |
|---|---|---|---|
| todo-smoke-001 | 5 | 3 | 3 |
| todo-smoke-002 | 5 | 2 | 2 |
| todo-smoke-003 | 5 | 4 | 4 |

An extra selected path with baseline-identical output would now fail the test
via `generation_paths_requested` even if it disappears from the workspace-diff
set. Agent cells additionally report `selection_calls=4`, `tool_calls=3`,
`inspected=1`, total calls 6–8.

## Negative controls (10) — corrected wording

- `dry_run=True` → **valid guarded no-op mode**: status `succeeded`,
  `dry_run=True`, zero model calls, no workspace diff.
- `enable_regeneration=False` → **valid guarded no-op mode**: status
  `succeeded`, zero regeneration calls.
- `fail_mode="zero_calls"` → failed control: stage `regeneration`,
  `FailureKind.model_output`, message contains `zero generation calls`, plus
  `generation_guard` failure.
- `fail_mode="empty_source"` → failed control: first failure stage
  `regeneration` with `Empty generation`, plus `generation_guard`.
- `editable_artifact_paths=()` → failed control: stage `runner`,
  `FailureKind.infrastructure`, `non-empty` (resolve_allowed_artifacts).
- `pre_apply_migration=True` with no new migration → **failed validation
  control**: status `failed`, stage `migration_generation`,
  `migration_generation_passed=False`.
- missing `python_executable` → failed control: stage `scenario_evaluator`
  before subprocess.
- vacuous `validation_command` → failed control: stage `scenario_evaluator`
  (baseline passes, evaluator fails).
- mutated snapshot → failed control proving an accepted-hash → mutated-hash
  transition: `snapshot_hash_before != snapshot_hash_after`, status `failed`,
  stage `runner`, message identifies the invalid active snapshot path.
- zeroed persisted metrics → detected via reconstruction.

## Leakage controls (8)

- Backend source omits ground truth.
- No evaluator/strategy imports in the scripted backend.
- Production `src/benchmark` free of `tests.support`.
- LLM registry and `seven_arm_benchmark.py` exclude scripted.
- Kaggle `choices=["mock", "kaggle-qwen", "openrouter"]` excludes scripted.
- `RepositoryTools` rejects `evaluator_assets` reads and listing.
- No evaluator assets in the workspace.
- AST-based name/module checks (not raw text) because the backend module
  docstring legitimately names `scenario.expected_affected_artifacts`.
